# Find Convex projects (`find_convex_projects`)

MCP tool `repository_convex_findProjects` · scope `access_provider_connections` · read_only

Reads the repository's exact default-branch Git tree to find explicit convex.json files and default
package.json plus convex/ layouts. Discovery uses exact tree entry types, paths, and object SHAs
only. It does not read or validate convex.json or package.json contents. It also lists projects
available through the connected Convex team. Each project gets one attachment status: attached when
this Samebase repository already records it, attached_elsewhere when another Samebase repository
records it, otherwise attachable. attached_elsewhere never names the other repository.

The MCP result lists the code location paths, the attachable projects with their production
deployment, and a count of the other projects. A project without a production deployment can be
attached, but its deploy key cannot be installed until it is deployed to production. A partial
source scan never proves that an unlisted code location is absent. Discovery may refresh private
Samebase provider-connection bookkeeping, but it does not change GitHub, Convex, Cloudflare, or
public internet state.

## Arguments

- `repository` (string, required): The repository as GitHub owner/name, or its repositoryId from
  repository_list.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "codeLocations": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "completeness": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "const": "complete"
            },
            {
              "const": "partial"
            }
          ]
        },
        "paths": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      },
      "required": ["completeness", "paths"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    },
    "projects": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "projectName": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "productionDeployment": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "state": {
                    "const": "available"
                  },
                  "region": {
                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "const": "aws-us-east-1"
                      },
                      {
                        "const": "aws-eu-west-1"
                      },
                      {
                        "const": "aws-ca-central-1"
                      },
                      {
                        "const": "aws-ap-southeast-2"
                      }
                    ]
                  }
                },
                "required": ["state", "region"],
                "additionalProperties": false
              },
              {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "state": {
                    "const": "missing"
                  }
                },
                "required": ["state"],
                "additionalProperties": false
              }
            ]
          }
        },
        "required": ["projectName", "productionDeployment"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    },
    "counts": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "attached": {
          "type": "number"
        },
        "attachedElsewhere": {
          "type": "number"
        }
      },
      "required": ["attached", "attachedElsewhere"],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": ["codeLocations", "projects", "counts"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
